body:
Advisor:

PR #2676 for BUG-2148 is open and ready for review:
- PR: https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2676
- Number: #2676
- Head SHA: ef72614b211f49c355bb68b6998054e4a50dca9f

Summary of work:
1. Gated terminate_pids_with_grace kill signals (both SIGTERM and SIGKILL) on strict positive start-time identity matching via aida_core::liveness::process_identity_matches_strict. Unknown, unparsable, cross-scheme or mismatched identities are never signalled, and are reported. Re-checked before SIGKILL to protect against PID reuse during the grace window.
2. Preserved start identity in AgentRegistryView (added pub(crate) pid_start: Option<String>) populated in view_for from entry.pid_start and in lease_agent_view from lease.creator_pid_start_time.
3. Updated agent_stop to partition matched agents:
   - Genuinely gone PIDs: reaped stale entry.
   - PIDs alive in OS with unconfirmed / recycled identity: reported unconfirmed identity, not signalled, reaped stale entry.
   - Confirmed matching processes: signalled with grace.
4. In session_end, captured start identity at probe time for leaked processes, and passed TerminateTarget to terminate_pids_with_grace.
5. Added unit tests in aida-cli-lib/src/tests/bug_2148_liveness_kill_signal_tests.rs covering recycled-PID fixture (same PID, historical start time), unknown (None), garbage, and non-canonical formats (asserting no signal is sent), plus positive control.
6. Mutation check verified: disabling the identity check in terminate_pids_with_grace causes the recycled-PID test to fail.
7. Verification: cargo test -p aida-cli-lib bug_2148 passed (2 passed); make check-ci-fast passed (29 gates passed); make check-ci-compile passed cleanly under agent profile.
subject: PR #2676 (BUG-2148) ready for review
